sa: काममभ्यस वा मा वा न मे जीवन् प्रमोक्ष्यसे। सुदृष्टः क्रियतां भीष्मं लोकोऽयं समितिंजय॥
en: Having heard these words of mine do what you think to be your duty. Whether you strike me or not, you shall not escape me alive this day. So, O ever-victorious Bhishma, let your eyes take a good view of this world, (as they will no longer see its charms).”

sa: द्रोणं पञ्चाशताविध्यद् विंशत्या च बृहद्बलम्। आशीत्या कृतवर्माणं कृपं षष्टया शिलीमुखैः॥ रुक्मपुथैर्महावेगैराकर्णसमचोदितैः। अविध्यद् दशभिर्वाणैरश्वत्थामानमार्जुनिः॥
en: And he then pierced Drona with fifty arrows and Brihadvala with twenty; and Kritavarman with eighty and Kripa with sixty, the son of Arjuna then pierced Ashvatthaman with ten shafts furnished with wings of gold, charged with great forces and shot from the bow drank back to the very ear.

sa: ते वयं नयमास्थाय शत्रुदेहसमीपगाः। कथमन्तं न गच्छेम वृक्षस्येव नदीरयाः। पररन्ध्र पराक्रान्ताः स्वरन्ध्रावरणे स्थिताः॥
en: When such is the case, why should we not, with the aid of good policy, go to the enemy and kill him as a river uproots a tree? if hiding our own drawbacks and taking advantage of his holes (faults), we attack the enemy, why should we not be successful?

sa: तां चैवावयां स्त्रियमतिरूपयुक्तां दिव्यां साक्षात् सोमवह्निप्रकाशाम्। योग्यां तेषां रूपतेजोयशोभिः पत्नी मत्वा दृष्टवान् पार्थिवेन्द्रः॥
en: Looking at his daughter, that foremost of women possessing great beauty as that of a celestial maiden and splendour as that of the fire or the moon, the king considered, that for her beauty, splendour and fame, she is really worthy to be th y wife of those celestial beings.

sa: वैश्योऽधीत्य ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियांश्च धनैः काले संविभज्याश्रितांश्च। त्रेतापूतं धूममाघ्राय पुण्यं प्रेत्य स्वर्गे दिव्यसुखानि भुङ्क्ते॥
en: A Shudra, after worshipping in due order Brahmanas, Kshatriyas and Vaishyas; and a Vaishya, having completed his study and on distributed his wealth among Brahmanas and Kshatriyas and among his dependents and after having smelt the sacred smokes purified by the three sorts of fire, enjoy heavenly bliss after death.

sa: वेदोऽधीतश्चरितं ब्रह्मचर्य यज्ञैरिष्टं ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च दत्तम्। परं स्थानं मन्यमानेन भूय आत्मा दत्तो वर्षपूगं सुखेभ्यः॥
en: The Vedas have been read by you; the hard austerities of Brahmacharya have been practised by you and in sacrificial ceremonies the desires of Brahmanas have been fulfilled by you and with the other world before your mind, your soul has been devoted to happiness for a series of years.

sa: अभिमन्योर्विनाशेन द्रौपदेयवधेन च॥ पञ्चालानां विनाशेन कुरूणां पतनेन च। ततः शतगुणं दुःखमिदं मामस्पृशद् मशम्॥
en: The grief I fell at Karna's death is a hundred times great than that felt for the death of Abhimanyu and the sons of Draupadi, and the destruction of the Panchalas and the Kurus! Thinking of Karna, I am burning with grief, like a person thrown into a burning fire.

sa: ततो देवो महादेवः शूलपाणिर्भगाक्षिहा॥ सम्प्रगृह्य तु निस्त्रिंशं कालाग्निसमवर्चसम्। त्रिकूटं चर्म चोद्यम्य सविद्युतमिवाम्बुदम्। चचार विविधान् मार्गान् महाबलपराक्रमः॥ विधुन्वन्नसिमाकाशे तथा युद्धचिकीर्षया।
en: Taking up the sword which was effulgent like the all-destructive Yuga fire, and wielding a large shield with three high bosses which shone like a mass of dark clouds stricken with flashes of lightning, the divine Mahadeva, the bearer of the Shula, the tearer of Bhaga's eye, began to perform various kinds of evolutions. Endued with great with great prowess, he began to whirl the sword in the sky, seeking an encounter. an

sa: तमिन्द्रियाणि सर्वाणि नानुपश्यन्ति पञ्चधा। आहुश्चै केचिदग्नि केचिदाहुः प्रजापतिम्॥ ऋतून् मासार्धमासांश्च दिवसांश्च क्षणांस्तथा। पूर्वाह्लमपराहं च मध्याह्नमपि चापरे॥ मुहूर्तमपि चैवाहुरेकं सन्तमनेकधा। तं कालमिति जानीहि यस्य सर्वमिदं वशे॥
en: All the five senses cannot perceive Brahma. Some have said that Brahma is Fire ; some that he is Prajapati, some that he is the Seasons; some that he is the Month; some that he is the Fortnight; some that he is the Days; some that he is the Hours; some that he is the Morning; some that he is the Noon; some that he is the Evening, and some that he is the Moment. Thus various people speak variously of him, who is one. Know that he is Eternity, under whose control exist all things.

sa: एवं दुर्मर्षितो राजा स मात्रा बभ्रुवाहनः । मनश्चक्रे महातेजा युद्धाय भरतर्षभ।॥ संना काञ्चनं वर्म शिरस्त्राणं च भानुमत्। तूणीरशतसम्बाधमारुरोह रथोत्तमम्॥ सर्वोपकरणोपेतं युक्तमश्वैर्मनोजवैः। स चक्रोपस्करं श्रीमान् हेमभाण्डपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: Thus was king Babhruvahana incited against his father by his (step) mother. At last, gifted as he was with great energy, he made up his mind, O chief of the Bharatas, to fight Dhananjaya, Putting on his armour of bright gold and his shining head-dress, he got upon an excellent car which had hundreds of quivers ready on it. That car was equipped with necessaries for battle and had horses yoked to it which were fleet like the mind. It had excellent wheels and a strong Upashkara, and was adorned with golden ornaments of every sort.

sa: भीष्मः सेनापतिरभूदेकादशचभूपतिः। कौरव्यः कौरवेन्द्राणां देवानामिव वासवः॥
en: Bhishma of Kuru's race became the Commander-in-chief, having eleven divisions of the Kaurava princes under his command, like Vasava of the celestial forces.

sa: यथा तदभवद् युद्धं पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। भीष्मकर्णकृपद्रोणशल्यादिभिरनुत्तमम्॥ अन्येषां क्षत्रियाणां च कृतास्त्राणामनेकशः। नानावेषाकृतिमतां नानादेशनिवासिनाम्॥
en: Indeed, tell me how that battle took place between the great Pandavas and Bhishma and Karna and Kripa and Drona and Shalya and others, between, in fact, numerous other Kshatriyas well-skilled in arms, differing from one another in conduct and dress and coming from various kingdoms.

sa: नाम संकीर्तयेत् तस्या यथासंख्योत्तरं स वै। फलं षट्त्रिंशदष्टौ च सहस्राणि च विंशतिः॥
en: These are the words that should be uttered according to the kind of gift mentioned above. The reward that was reaped by making gifts of kine is residence in the celestial region for six and thirty thousand years, eight thousand years, and twenty thousand years respectively.

sa: हतं कृपणवित्तं हि राष्ट्र हन्ति नृपश्रियम्। दद्याच्च महतो भोगान् क्षुद्भयं प्रणुदेत् सताम्॥
en: The riches taken from the poor and the helpless is sure to destroy the kingdom and prosperity of the king. The king should always present to the righteous all enjoyable articles in abundance. He should certainly remove the fear of famishing which those men may have.

sa: सभाज्यमानः शुशुभे महेन्द्रस्त्रिदशैरिव॥ पाण्डवाश्च महीपालैः समेतैरभिसंवृताः।
en: The sons of Pandu, surrounded by the assembled kings, looked as beautiful, O king, as the planets in the midst of the stars.

sa: मत्स्ययोनिमनुप्राप्य मृतो जायति मानुषः। मानुषत्वमनुप्राप्य क्षीणायुरुपपद्यते॥
en: Having lived for sometime as a fish, he dies and regains the human form. Regaining, however, the human form he becomes short lived.

sa: अहं च निर्गुणोऽनन्तः सप्तैते मोक्षहेतवः॥ विदुषां बुध्यमानानां स्वं स्वं स्थानं यथाविधि। गुणास्ते देवताभूताः सततं भुञ्जते हविः॥ अदन्नन्नान्यथोऽविद्वान् ममत्वेनोपपद्यते।
en: As regards the soul, that is destitute of qualities. These seven are the causes of Liberation. With them who are learned and gifted with sufficient understanding, the qualities, which are in the position of celestials, eat the oblations, each in its proper place, and according to what has been ordained. The person who is shorn of learning, eating various kinds of food, becomes seized with the sense of egoism.

sa: ततः शिरांसि दीप्तायैस्तेषां चिच्छेद पाण्डवः॥ क्षुरैर्गाण्डपवनिर्मुक्तैर्नातियत्नादिवार्जुनः।
en: Then Arjuna, carelessly shooting from Gandiva many arrows with razor-like heads that blazed with splendour, cut off the heads of many Gandhara warriors.

sa: सुस्वभावा सुवचना सुवृत्ता सुखदर्शना। अनन्यचित्ता सुमुखी भर्तुः सा धर्मचारिणी॥ सा भवेद् धर्मपरमा सा भवेद् धर्मभागिनी। देववत् सततं साध्वी या भर्तारं प्रपश्यति॥ शुश्रूषां परिचारं च देववद् या करोति च। नाम्यभावा ह्याविमनाः सुव्रता सुखदर्शना॥ पुत्रवक्त्रमिवाभीक्ष्णं भुर्तुर्वदनमीक्षते। या साध्वी नियताहारा सा भवेद् धर्मचारिणी॥ श्रुत्वा दम्पतिधर्मं वै सहधर्मं कृतं शुभम्। या भवेद् धर्मपरमा नारी भर्तृसपव्रता॥ देववत् सततं साध्वी भर्तारमनुपश्यति। दम्पत्योरेष वै धर्मः सहधर्मकृतः शुभः॥ शुश्रूषां परिचारं च देव
en: Gifted with a good disposition, endued with sweet speech, sweet conduct, and sweet features, and always loO king at the face of her husband and deriving as much joy from it as she does from loO king at the face of her child, that chaste woman who regulates her deeds by observing the prescribed restraints, comes to be considered as truly righteous in her conduct. Listening to the duties of inarried life, and perforining all those sacred duties, that woman who considers virtue as the foremost of all objects of pursuit, who observes the same vows as those which are observed by her husband, who, adorned with chastity, looks upon her husband as a god, who waits upon and serves him as if he is a god, who surrenders her own will completely to that of her husband's, who is chcerful, who observes e

sa: अंगीरस उवाच सप्ताहं चन्द्रभागां वै वितस्तामूर्मिमालिनीम्। विगाह्य वै निराहारो निर्मलो मुनिवद् भवेत्॥
en: Angiras said A person by bathing for seven days successively in the Chandrabhaga or the Vitasta whose waters are always seen to dance in waves, fasting all the while, is sure to become purged of all his sins and endued with the merit of an ascetic.

sa: तर्पिताः सर्वकामैश्च रक्तचन्दनरुषिताः। अप्सरोगणसंयुक्ताः सैन्या वाचमुदीरयन्॥
en: And sumptuously entertained with every enjoyment, with their bodies decked with red sandal, the soldiery in the company of bevies of Apsaras, exclaimed.

sa: ततस्तौ द्रोणशैनेयो युयुधाते परंतपौ। शरैरनेकसाहस्रेस्ताडयन्तौ परस्परम्॥
en: Then those two afflicters of foes Drona and Yuyudhana began to fight with each other, striking each other with many a thousand shafts.

sa: भृग्वङ्गिरादिभिर्भूयस्तपसोत्थापितस्तदा। भृशं जज्वाल तेजस्वी तपसाऽऽप्यायित: शिखी।॥
en: He was roused by the penance of Bhrigu and Angirasa. The mighty Agni, thus gratified by their penance, blazed forth in great effulgence.

sa: कपालं वृक्षमूलानि कुचैलमसहायता। उपेक्षा सर्वभूतानामेतावद् भिक्षुलक्षणम्॥
en: The other marks of a mendicant are the human skull, protection under trees, rags for wearing, companionless solitude, and indifference to all creatures.

sa: ततः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैरिषुभिर्नतपर्वभिः॥ न्यवारयेतामन्योन्यं कांस्ये निर्भिद्य वर्मणी।
en: Then penetrating each other's brazen armours, they pierced each other with shafts of depressed knots, shot from bows drawn to the fullest stretch.

sa: सर्वतः प्रत्यवारयन्। गभसितभिरिवादित्यं तपन्तं भुवनं यथा॥
en: Firmly united together, those heroes surrounded Drona on all sides who was burning down everything, like sun scorching the world with his rays.

sa: अश्वारोहान् हतैरश्चैर्ग्रहीतासीन् समन्ततः। द्रवमाणानपश्याम द्राव्यमाणांश्च संयुगे॥
en: We also beheld horse soldiers, deprived of their charges chase and chased by, one another in that battle, with swords in their grasp.

sa: हेमकक्ष्याध्वजोपेतं क्लृप्तयन्त्रपताकिनम्। अग्यं रथं सुयन्तारं बहुशस्त्रपरिच्छदम्॥
en: Listen again to the (great) destruction (of creatures) brought about by your vile policy. Thirty-one of your sons have been destroyed by Bhimasena.

sa: ततस्तद्धनुरादाय तूणौ चाक्षय्यसायको। प्रादान्ममैव भगवान्धारयस्वेति चाव्रवीत्॥
en: Then, holding (my) bow and the two arrowcase furnished with inexhaustible shafts, that divine one returned them to me saying "crave some boon.

sa: एष शङ्खगदापाणिर्वासुदेवोऽतिवीर्यवान्। वाहयन्नेति तुरगान् पाण्डुरान् वातरंहसः॥
en: The highly energetic Vasudeva with club and Sranga bow in his hands is driving the yellow horses cndued with speed of the wind.

sa: शिरोभिः पातितैस्तत्र भूमिरासीनिरन्तरा। अभ्रच्छायेव चैवासीत् ध्वाक्षगृघ्रबलैयुधि॥
en: The field of battle was thickly strewn over with felled heads; and fights of vultures and crows and ravens formed its cloudy canopy.

sa: विप्रहीनरथाश्वाश्च शरैश्च परिवारिताः। पञ्चविंशतिसाहस्राः पार्थमार्छन् पदातयः॥
en: Deprived of cars and horses and struck with arrows from every side, five and twenty thousand foot-soldiers proceeded towards Partha and surrounded him.

sa: शृणु दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषं शङ्खशब्दांश्च पुष्कलान्। सिंहनादरवांश्चैव रथनेमिस्वनांस्तथा॥
en: Hear the roar of their drums and the full blasts of their conchs, the uproar of war-cries and the rattle of their car-wheels!

sa: महाधनुर्धरः श्रीमानमित्रगणमर्दनः। पुत्रः पाञ्चालराजस्य धृष्टद्युम्नो महायशाः॥
en: The son of the Panchala king, viz., the celebrated Dhrishtadyumna, was a great bowman possessed of great beauty and a repressor of foes.

sa: ऐकमत्यमुपागम्य शास्त्रदृष्टेन चक्षुषा। मन्त्रिणो यत्र निरतास्तमाहुर्मन्त्रमुत्तमम्॥
en: That counsel belongs to the superior order in which the counsellors with their judgement reinforced by a knowledge of political ethics, are unanimous.

sa: वैनतेयः स्थितस्तस्यां प्रभामण्डलरश्मिवान्। तस्य सत्यवतः केतुर्भुजगारिरदृश्यत॥
en: Upon that standard was Vinata's son, Garuda, that enemy of snakes perched on the standard-top of of Keshava is the embodiment of truth.

sa: संहारकाले सम्प्राप्ते तव क्रोधविनिःसृतः। संवर्तकाग्निस्त्रैलोक्यं भस्मीकृत्यावतिष्ठते॥
en: When the time for final dissolution comes, the Samvartaka fire, born of your anger, only exists and reduces the three worlds to ashes.

sa: क्षेत्रभूते ततस्तस्मिन्नोषधीरोषधीपतिः। दिवस्तेजः समुद्धृत्य जनयामास वारिणा॥
en: While the sun so stayed, the lord of the vegetable world (moon), converting the effects of the sun's heat (vapours) created the clouds.

sa: वयं प्रतिनदन्तस्तानगच्छाम त्वरान्विताः। सहसैवाभिसंक्रुद्धास्तदाऽऽसीत् तुमुलं महत्॥
en: All inflamed with rage. Thereupon ensued an awful and fierce engagement, in which the soldiers, rushing at one another, smote one another down.

sa: पतितं चैनमालोक्य समन्ताद् भरतस्त्रियः। परिवर्महारुजमस्पृशंश्चैव पाणिभिः॥
en: Beholding that great king fallen down, the Bharata ladies surrounded him on all sides and began to chafe him (gently) with their hands.

sa: इन्द्रसोमाग्निवरुणा देवासुरमहोरगाः। प्रह्वास्त्वामुपतिष्ठन्ति स्तुवन्तो विविधैः स्तवैः॥
en: Indra, Soma, Agni and Varuna, the celestial, the Asuras and the great Nagas, all wait upon you and adore you with various hymns.

sa: कच्चिन्मित्राणि लभतेऽमित्रैश्चाप्यभिगम्यते। कच्चित् कल्याणमित्रश्च मित्रैश्चापि पुरस्कृतः॥
en: Is he still gaining friends and are friends gathering around him? Is he welcoming his friends and are they honouring him the more?

sa: अथाजग्मुर्नरश्रेष्ठा नानाजनपदेश्वराः। ब्राह्मणाश्च महाभाग धार्तराष्ट्रपुरं प्रति॥
en: Then there came to the city of Dhritarashtra many foremost of men, the rulers of various countries and also many highly virtuous Brahmanas.

sa: सोऽज्ञायमानः पुरुषानवधाय समन्ततः। स्वयमारान्निलीनोऽभूद् भार्गवस्य निवेशने॥
en: Having sent away all his attendants, he concealed himself unknown to the Pandavas in a place somewhere near the house of the potter.

sa: स दर्शपौर्णमासाभ्यां कालेष्वाग्रयणेन च। चातुर्मास्यैश्च विविधैर्यज्ञैश्चावाप्तदक्षिणैः॥
en: Then king Gaya celebrated for a full hundred years, various kinds of sacrifices with profuse Dakshinas, as also many other vows as Chaturmasya.

sa: नाधर्मेण न धर्मेण बध्यन्ते छिन्नसंशयाः। प्रलयोत्पत्तितत्त्वज्ञाः सर्वज्ञाः सर्वदर्शिनः॥ वीतरागा विमुच्यन्ते पुरुषाः कर्मबन्धनैः।
en: Those men who are freed froin all doubts, who are gifted with omniscience, and who have eyes for seeing all things, are never fettered by either virtue or sin. Those men who are shorn of all attachments, can never be fettered by the chains of action.

sa: हतशिष्टाः सरुधिरा भिन्नमस्तकपिण्डिकाः। कुञ्जरा वर्जयामासुसुयुधानरथं तथा॥
en: Of the elephant hosts, then began to break away leaning the car of Yuyudhana. Then the noise that your troops created, O sire.

sa: विवृत्तकमायतनो नूनं संचितसंचयः। आषाढीमभ्युपगतो भरतः कोसलाधिपः॥
en: Having roofed all his houses and stored up his food, Bharata, the king of Kosala has set upon the performance of Așara sacrifices.

sa: विमोचनमुपस्पृश्य जितमन्युर्जितेन्द्रियः। प्रतिग्रहकृतैर्दोषैः सर्वैः स परिमुच्यते॥
en: Bathing there in the Tirtha called Vimochana with passions and senses subdued, one is cleansed of all his sins derived from receiving gifts.

sa: नीलभास्वरवर्णश्च पादैपरुपशोभितम्। भ्रमरैरुपगीतं च पक्षिभिश्च महायशाः॥
en: Adorned with trees of blue and bright colours and ringing with the hum of bees and warbling of birds. And that highly renowned.

sa: स विदेहानतिक्रम्य समृद्धजनसेवितान्। मिथिलोपवनं रम्यमाससाद समृद्धिमत्॥
en: Passing through the Videha country full of rich people, he arrived at the delightful gardens of Mithila rich with many sorts to trees.

sa: आचारप्रभवो धर्मो धर्मादायुर्विवर्धते॥ एतद् यशस्यमायुष्यं स्वयं स्वस्त्ययनं महत्। अनुकम्प्य सर्ववर्णान् ब्रह्मणा समुदाहृतम्॥
en: It is conduct which begets virtue, and it is virtue which prolongs life. Conduct gives fame, long life, and Heaven. Conduct is the most efficacious rite of propitiating the celestials. The self-create Brahman himself has said that one should show mercy to all orders of men.

sa: ततोऽहं लघुभिश्चित्रैर्ब्रह्मास्त्रपरिमन्त्रितैः। व्यधर्म सायकैराशु शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Thereupon, I began to consume them with hundreds and thousands of ornamented swift arrows inspired with Mantras relating to the weapon of Brahma.

sa: दारुणेषु च सर्वेषु प्रत्यरिं च विवर्जयेत्। ज्योतिषे यानि चोक्तानि तानि सर्वाणि वर्जयेत्।।१२७
en: The Shraddha should never be performed under any of those constellations that are considered as dreadful (such as Ashlesha, etc.,) and any of those that upon calculation, seem to be hostile. Indeed, in this matter, all these constellations should be avoided which are forbidden in astrology.

sa: असुरैनित्यमुदितैः शूलटिमुसलायुधैः। चापमुद्गरहस्तैश्च स्रग्विभिः सर्वतो वृतम्॥
en: Surrounded on all sides by the Asuras, always cheerful, adorned with garlands and holding in their hands maces, swords, darts, bows and clubs.

sa: इयं राजर्षिभिर्याता पुण्यकृद्भिर्युधिष्ठिर। मन्वादिभिर्महाराज तीर्थयात्रा भयापहा॥
en: O great king Yudhishthira, Manu and other Rishis of virtuous deeds had visited the Tirthas, for a visit to them dispels all fears.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा पृथिवीपाला: सर्वे हृच्छयपीडिताः। त्वरिताः समुपाजग्मुर्दमयन्तीमभीप्सवः॥
en: Hearing this, all the rulers of the carth, repressed by her love and filled with the desire for Damayanti, repaired (to the Svayamvara).

sa: ते तु दृष्ट्वैव कौन्तेयमजिनैः प्रतिवासितम्। रुक्माङ्गदधरं वीरं भीमं भीमपराक्रमम्॥ सायुधं बद्धनिस्त्रिंशमशङ्कितमरिदमम्। पुष्करेप्सुमुपायान्तमन्योन्यमभिचक्रुशुः॥
en: As that chastiser of foes, that son of Kunti, Bhima of fearful prowess clad in deer skins, wearing golden armlets and girding on his sword, fearlessly proceeded with the desire of gathering those lotuses, the Rakshasas saw him; and they immediately shouted out addressing one another.

sa: श्रीपर्वतं समासाद्य नदीतीरमुपस्पृशेत्॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति पूजयित्वा वृषध्वजम्।
en: Going to the mountain, called Sri, one should bathe in the river. Worshipping Vrishadhvaja, a (Shiva) one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sa: तं वज्रनिष्पेषसममास्फोटितमहारवम्। श्रुत्वा शैलगुहासुप्तैः सिंहैर्मुक्तो महास्वनः॥
en: Hearing those loud striking of his arms resembling the roaring of thunder, the lions sleeping in their caves (awoke and) uttered great howls.

sa: पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण हेमदण्डेन चारुणा। दिव्यगन्धाधिवासेन व्यजनेन विधूयता॥
en: A beautiful white umbrella having a golden staff, was held over his head; he was fanned by a chamara perfumed with celestials fragrance.

sa: धनंजयवियोगाच्च राज्यभ्रंशाच्च दुःखिताः। अथ भीमो महाबाहुर्युधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥
en: Thereupon the heroic Bhima, afflicted with sorrow for the separation of Dhananjaya and the loss of kingdom, addressed Yudhishthira in the following terms.

sa: ते मामूचुर्महाराज सान्त्वयित्वा नरर्षभ। सव्यसाचिन् निरीक्षास्मॉल्लोकपालानवस्थितान्॥
en: Having cheered me up, O great king, O best of mortals, they said to me, “O Savyasachi, behold us the Lokapalas seated (here).

sa: विश्वावसुप्रभृतिभिर्गन्धर्वैः स्तुतिवन्दनैः। स्तूयमानं द्विजावयैश्च ऋग्यजुः सामसम्भवैः॥
en: He was eulogised by many Gandharvas headed by Vishvavasu and others, by bards and singers and leading Brahmanas chanting Rig and Yaju hymns.

sa: कृशांश्च वातातपकर्शिताङ्गान् दुःखस्य चोचस्य मुखे प्रपन्नान्। तां चाप्यनाथामिव वीरनाथां कृष्णां परिक्लेशगुणेन युक्ताम्॥
en: All of whom having fallen into great misery had become emaciated and reduced owing to exposure to the wind and the sun. He also talked of Krishna (Draupadi) who had been overwhelmed with sufferings and who had become protectorless though she had heroes for her lords.

sa: तं स कृष्णानिलोद्भूतो दिव्यास्त्रज्वलनो महान्। श्वेतवाजिबलाकाभृद् गाण्डीवेन्द्रायुधोल्बणः॥ संरब्धः शरधाराभिः सुदीप्तं कर्णपावकम्। अर्जुनोदीरितो मेघः शमयिष्यति संयुगे॥ स साक्षादेव सर्वाणि शक्रात् परपुरंजयः। दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि बीभत्ससुस्ततश्च प्रतिपत्स्यते॥
en: Only that mass of clouds, namely Arjuna assisted by Krishna, who is like the powerful wind, his celestials weapons representing fearful lightning (in that cloud) his white steeds representing white cranes flying underneath (those clouds) his unbearable Gandiva representing the rainbow, (that Arjuna only) is capable of extinguishing that blazing flame, namely Karna, by means of the shower of his arrows shot with unflagging steadiness. That conqueror of hostile heroes, Vibhatsu (Arjuna) will certainly succeed in obtaining all the celestials weapons with their fullness and life from Indra.

sa: तथा विलपतीमेकामरण्ये भीमनन्दिनीम्। दमयन्तीमथोचुस्ते तापसा: सत्यदर्शिनः॥
en: Those truth-seeing ascetics then said unto the forlorn Damayanti, the daughter of Bhima, who had been bewailing for her lord in the forest.

sa: अभिगच्छन्ति राजेन्द्र चैत्रशुक्लचतुर्दशीम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र विन्देद् बहुसुवर्णकम्। सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: On the fourteenth day of the white fortnight of Chaitra, O king of kings, O foremost of men, bathing there one obtains the fruits of giving away much wealth. His sins being all destroyed and his soul becoming pure, he goes to the region of Brahma.

sa: कृशानार्थांस्ततः केचिदकृशांस्तत्र कुर्वते। अकृशांश्च कृशाश्चर्हेतुभिः शास्त्रानिश्चयैः॥
en: Some amongst the disputants made the weaker arguments to appear stronger, and the stronger ones the weaker by their arguments based on Shastras.

sa: माकाशमास्थाय विमूढसंज्ञाः। कैलासशृङ्गाण्यभिदुद्रुवुस्ते भीमार्दिताः क्रोधवशा: प्रभग्नाः॥
en: Beaten and pierced by Bhimasena, those Krodhavasas left the field of battle and confusedly and hurriedly fled towards Kailasha mountain through the sky.

sa: मधुस्रवैः सदा दिव्यां महर्षिगणसेविताम्। मदप्रमुदितैर्नित्यं नानाद्विजगणैर्युताम्॥
en: All dropping excellent honey. It was frequented by the great Rishis and it was always inhabited by various birds maddened with animal spirits.

sa: यथाधनंजयः पार्थस्तपस्वी नियतव्रतः। मुनिरेकचरः श्रीमान्धर्मो विग्रहवानिव॥
en: He heard that Dhananjaya Partha (Arjuna) engaged in asceticism, observing vows of silence and deep in meditation, appeared like the blazing deity, Dharma.

sa: ते तथेत्येव कौरव्यमुक्त्वा वचनकारिणः। चिकीर्षन्तस्तदाऽऽक्रीडाञ्जग्मुद्वैतवनं सरः॥
en: Saying "So be it", they at the command of the king went towards the banks of the lake to build the pleasure houses.

sa: गङ्गाद्वारमथागम्य भगवानृषिसत्तमः। उग्रमातिष्ठत तपः सह पल्यानुकूलया॥
en: Coming to the source of the Ganges that exalted one, that foremost of Rishis, began to perform severe austerities with his helpful wife.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच मा स्म ते ते गृहे राजञ्छात्रवाणामपिध्रुवम्। वातसारथिरागन्ता गर्भं सुषुवतुश्च तम्॥
en: Ashtavakra said : O king, may God keep away from your house those two (thunder and lightning), nay cven from the house of your enemies. He who appears with the wind as his charioteer (cloud or mind) gives, birth to them and they also produce him.

sa: ऋषभद्वीपमासाद्य मेध्यं क्रौञ्चनिषूदनम्। सरस्वत्यामुपस्पृश्य विमानस्थो विराजते॥
en: Going then to the island called Rishabha and Kraunchanishudana which destroys all sins and bathing in the Sarasvati one blazes forth in heaven.

sa: ब्राह्मणैश्च महाभागैर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः। नित्यमन्वास्यसे राजंस्तत्र का परिदेवना॥
en: O king, what cause is there for your sorrow, when you are always mixing with the greatly exalted Brahmanas learned in the Vedas?

sa: दशाऱ्यानि सहस्राणि येषामन्नं सुसंस्कृतम्। ह्रियते रुक्मपात्रीभिर्यतीनामूवरेतसाम्॥
en: Besides these, ten thousand Yatis with their desire under complete control had their pure and well-cooked food carried to them in golden plates.

sa: ततो नन्दाप्लुताङ्गस्त्वं कौशिकीमभियास्यसि। विश्वामित्रेण यत्रोग्रं तपस्तप्तमनुत्तमम्॥
en: Then washing your body in the Nanda, you will go to the Kaushiki where the excellent and severe asceticism was performed by Vishvamitra.

sa: कुवलाश्वस्य धुन्धोश्च युद्धकौतूहलान्विताः। देवगन्धर्वसहिताः समवैक्षन् महर्षयः॥
en: Propelled by curiosity the celestials with the Gandharvas, as well as the great sages, beheld from heaven the combat between Kuvalashva and Dhundhu.

sa: सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपाहरत्। ततोऽविध्यच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्॥
en: With a bhalla then he felled his adversary's charioteer from his nich in the car and with four arrows wounded the four steeds.

sa: तैर्व्यवाहरदार्यात्मा मुहूर्तादेव सात्यकिः। ततः कलिङ्गैर्युयुधे सोऽचिन्त्यबलविक्रमः॥
en: The illustrious Satyaki fought with them only for a while and then that hero of inconceivable prowess commenced his fight with the Kalingas.

sa: सेनापत्येन सत्कर्तुं कर्णं स्कन्दमिवामराः। ततोऽभिषिषिचुः कर्णं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥ दुर्योधनमुखा राजन् राजानो विजयैषिणः।
en: As the commander of his force, even as the gods do to lord Skanda. Thereupon, monarch, all the kings, at the head of whom was Duryodhana, who were most desirous of victory, installed Karna (in the generalship of army), according to the rites ordained by Providence.

sa: आवृतं हि निवर्तेत प्रयोक्तारं न संशयः॥
en: That weapon never comes back, neither, O king, can it be used twice. If invoked back it will slay the person invoking it.

sa: उनहार शरं घोरं पाण्डवोऽनलसंनिभम्॥ इन्द्राशनिसमप्रख्यं दिव्यमस्त्राभिमन्त्रितम्।
en: Pandu's son took up a terrible shaft of the splendour of fire. Appearing like the thunderbolt of Indra and inspired with sacred Mantras.

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम भीमसेनस्य विक्रमम्। संवार्याधिरथिं बाणैर्यञ्जघान तवात्मजान्॥
en: Then we beheld the wonderful prowess of Bhimasena, inasmuch as he succeeded in slaying your sons and withstanding Karna with his arrows simultaneously.

sa: मोहयित्वा रणे पार्थान् वज्रहस्त इवासुरान्। स कथं निहतः शेते वायुरुग्ण इव द्रुमः॥
en: And also having rendered the Parthas senseless in battle, even as Indra with the thunderbolt in his hand, stupifying the Asuras, how has that great car-warrior (Karna) been slain in battle, who now lies dead (in the field) like a large tree up-rotted by the wind.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनं वृष्णिवीरस्त्वरितो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। धनुर्विस्फारयात्यर्थमहं ध्यास्यामि चाम्बुजम्॥
en: Thereafter, the Vrishni Vrishni hero quickly addressed Arjuna saying "Do you tremendously stretch your bow for I will blow this conch of mine.

sa: कचित् क्षेनं तु नृपतेः कचिजीवति सैन्धवः॥
en: "O Dussana, why are all these car-warriors, flying away? Is everything right with the king? Does the king of the Sindhus still live?

sa: अभ्यद्रवत् ततो द्रोणो यदुवीरजिघांसया। तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः॥
en: Drona desirous of slaying the heroic (Yadu rushed (at him). Seeing (i.e. Drona advance), Yudhishthira (putting himself) at the head (of his troops).

sa: सपर्वतवना राजन् सपादपजलाशया। सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासैः सर्वतस्तैर्महारथैः॥
en: With her mountains, forests trees and watery expanses. O king, pierced deeply by those mighty car-warriors, those fierce bowmen from all sides, Alambusha.

sa: पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मन्वानाः पुरुषर्षभाः। अलायुधं राक्षसेन्द्रं स्वागतेनाभ्यपूजयन्॥
en: Having received Alayudha, that foremost prince of the Rakshasas, with a respectful welcome, the kings of your army considered themselves as born anew.

sa: तेषां दानवमुख्यानां प्रयुतान्तयर्बुदानि च॥ कोट्यश्चाप्रतिवीराणां समाजग्मुस्ततस्ततः।
en: Thereupon millions and millions of from all directions proceeded against those best of the Danavas who had no hordes to come against them.

sa: न हि मे समरे शक्ताः समुद्यातुं सुरासुराः। किमु पाण्डुसुता राजन् रणे मानुषयोनयः॥
en: Even the very celestials and the Asuras will not be able to proceed against me in the field. O monarch, what should I say of the sons of Pandu, who are of human origin and who will not be capable of withstanding me in the battle.

sa: सम्भ्रान्तनरनागाश्वमावर्तत मुहुर्मुहुः। तत् सैन्चमिषुभिस्तेन वध्यमानं समन्ततः॥
en: That host consisting of terrified warriors, clephants and horses, carnaged on all sides by the arrows of Satyaki, began to turn round repeatedly.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नोऽभ्ययाद् राजन् सात्यकिश्च महाबलः। चण्डवाताभिपन्नानामुदधीनामिव स्वनः॥
en: Dhristadyumna as well as the highly powerful Satyaki rushed (at them) like the roar of waters dashed into fury by a terrible hurricane.

sa: इषीका वा यथा मुजे पृथक् च सह चैव च। तथैव सहितोवेतावन्योन्यस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितौ॥
en: As the blade in a clump of grass though distinct from the clump, exists in a state of union with it, so these two, though different from each other and each exists in its own self, are to be seen in a state of perpetual union.

sa: नासत्यश्चैव दस्रश्च स्मृतौ द्वावश्विनावपि। मार्तण्डस्यात्मजावेतावष्टमस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Nasatya and Dashra are mentioned as the two Ashvins. These two are the sons of the illustrious Martanda, the eighth in the above.

sa: जनकस्त्वभिसंरक्तः कापिलेयानुदर्शनात्। उत्सृज्य शतमाचार्यान् पृष्ठतोऽनुजगाम तम्॥
en: Marking the genius of the son of Kapila, Janaka became exceedingly attacked to him, and abandoning his hundred preceptors, began to follow him.

sa: घोरैः प्रहरणैश्चान्यैः क्षुरधारैरयोमयैः। ततस्तु दानवानीकं सम्प्रणेतारमुच्यतम्॥
en: However, seeing that foremost of all beings, the indestructible powerful Rudra, swelling with might, the Danavas army became stupefied and began to tremble.

sa: यद्वत् कान्तारमातिष्ठन्नौत्सुक्यं समनुव्रजेत्। ग्राम्यमाहारमादद्यादस्वाद्वपि हि यापनम्॥
en: Giving up all desire (for rich food) herinits living in the forest take simple and unsavoury food, for only keeping up the body.

sa: व्यक्तं मृत्युमुखं विद्यादव्यक्तमृतं पदम्। प्रवृत्तिलक्षणं धर्ममृषिर्नारायणोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: That which is manifest is subject to death. That which is unmanifest transcends, death. The Rishi Narayana has described the religion of inclination.

sa: सुरासुरगुरोर्वक्त्रे कस्य रेत: पुरा हतम्। कस्य वाऽन्यस्य रेतस्तद् येन हैमो गिरिः कृतः।।२१६
en: Was not the seminal fluid of Mahadeva, that Master of both the gods and the Asuras, poured as a libation upon the fire? From that seed originated a mountain of gold. Who else is there whose seed can be said to be possessed of such power.

sa: बाल्याद् वा संशयाद् वापि भयाद् वाप्यविमोक्षजात्। उत्पन्ने चापि विज्ञाने नाधिगच्छति तां गतिम्॥
en: Whether in consequence of your tender age, or of the doubts you have not been able to remove, or of the fear that is due to be unattainment of Liberation, you are conscious of that Knowledge due to Intuition, although it has originated in your mind.

sa: कराल मा ते भयमस्तु किञ्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं ब्रह्म परं त्वयाद्या यथावदुक्तं परमं पवित्रं विशोकमत्यन्तमनादिमध्यम्॥
en: O Karala, do not entertain any fear since you have heard all this regarding high Brahma from the to-day! I have described to you duly the high and holy Brahma that is without beginning and middle, and that is capable of removing all kinds of sorrow.

sa: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च जानीयामिति सत्तमाः॥
en: I have practised the austerest of penances. You best of men, I am fully conversant with the Past, the Present, and the Future.

sa: यातुधानाश्च बहवो राक्षसास्तिग्मतेजसः। मन्युनाऽऽविष्टदेहेन सृष्टाः कालान्तकोपमाः॥
en: While under the influence of ire, he created numberless evil spirits and Rakshasas of great vigour and resembling the great destroyer Kala himself.

sa: ऋषिभिर्यज्ञपटुभिर्यथावत् कर्मकर्तृभिः। समिद्भिः परिसंकीर्णं दीप्यमानैश्च पावकैः॥
en: The sacrificial altar was adorned with Rishis skilled in sacrifice and capable of performing all acts, with sacrificial fuel, and with burning fires.

sa: त्रीणि श्रोत्रियभार्यायां परदारे च द्वे स्मृते॥ काले चतुर्थे भुञ्जानो ब्रह्मचारी व्रती भवेत्।
en: For ravishing the wife of a Brahmana well read in the Vedas, one should, for three years, practise the vow of Brahmacharya, living on spare diet at the fourth part of the day. For ravishing any other woman one should undergo similar penances for two years.

sa: न च जीवं विना ब्रह्मन् वायवश्चेष्टयन्त्युत। स जीवः परिसंख्यातः शेषः संकर्षणः प्रभुः॥
en: Without, again, the entrance of Individual Soul into the body, the mind living within it cannot cause it move and act. He that enters the body is possessed of great power and is called Individual. He is known also by other names, viz., Shesha and Sankarshana.

sa: अथास्य बुद्धिरभवत् तपस्ये भरतर्षभ। ततोऽब्रवीत् कुलपतिं पादौ संगृह्य भारत॥ भवत्प्रसादादिच्छामि धर्म वक्तुं द्विजर्षभ। तन्मां त्वं भगवन् वक्तुं प्रव्राजयितुमर्हसि॥
en: Seeing everything, ( chief of Bharata's race, the Shudra felt inclined to devote himself to the practice of penances. Touching the feet of the head of the order, O Bharata, he said to hiin. Through your favour, O foremost of twice born persons, I wish to learn the duties of religion. You should, o illustrious one, describe to me those duties and introduce me into a life of Renunciation.

sa: सर्वाः स्वानालयान् यान्तु एका मामुपतिष्ठतु॥ प्रज्ञाता या प्रशान्ता या शेषा गच्छन्तु च्छन्दतः।
en: Having taken his seat, Ashtavakra said Let all the ladies go to their respective quarters. Only let one stay here. Let that one remain here who is endued with wisdom and who has tranquillity of heart. Indeed, let all the others go away as they like,

sa: सकृत्प्रभिन्नैश्च गजैर्विभूषितं प्रहष्टनानाविधपक्षिसेवितम्। महीरुहाणां च वनैर्विचित्रैः॥
en: It was full of Rurus and apes and tigers and lions and leopards, deer of various species and peacocks and cats and snakes.

sa: गिरेः सारं यथा हेम पुष्पसारं यथा मधु॥ घृतात् सारं यथा मण्डस्तथैतत् सारमुद्धृतम्।
en: As gold is the essence of rocky mountains, as honey is the essence of flowers, as Manda is the extract from clarified butter, so have these names been extracted from and represent the cream of those ten thousand names that were uttered by the Grandfather Brahman.

sa: मुचुकुन्दस्ततः क्रुद्धः प्रत्युवाच धनेश्वरम्। न्यायपूर्वमसंरब्धमसम्भ्रान्तमिदं वचः॥
en: Enraged at these words, Muchukunda, shorn of pride and fear, said to the Lord of Death these words pregnant with reason and justice.

sa: बुद्धिमान् वाक्यसम्पन्नस्तद्वाक्यमनुवर्णयन्। स्वामवस्थां समीक्ष्याथ साम्नैव प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: Reflecting upon his own condition, the highly intelligent and eloquent cat praised the words of the speaker and honoured him by gentle words.

sa: तस्योपलक्षये कृष्ण काऎरमिततेजसः। अभिमन्योर्हतस्यापि प्रभा नैवोपशाम्यति॥
en: I see, O Krishna, the splendour of that son of Arjuna, of that great hero, viz., Abhimanyu, has not diminished even in death.

sa: गम्यतां द्वारकां चेति सोऽन्वशादनुयायिनः। सोऽवतीर्याचलश्रेष्ठात् प्लक्षप्रस्रवणाच्छुभात्॥
en: He ordered his attendant saying-Return you to Dwaraka!' He then got down from that prince of mountains and that fair hermitage called Plakshaprashravana.

sa: स्वशिरः पञ्चशाखाभ्यामभिहत्यायतेक्षणा। पतत्युरसि वीरस्य कुरुराजस्य माधव॥
en: See, O Madhava, striking her head with her hands, she falls upon the breast of her heroic husband, the king of the Kurus.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तः पलितो मार्जारं वशमागतम्। वाक्यं हितमुवाचेदमभिनीतार्थमर्थवित्॥
en: Thus accosted, the mouse Palita, speaking again to the cat, who was entirely under his control, said these highly significant and wise words-

sa: त्रासनी सर्वभूतानां स्वसैन्यपरिहर्षिणीम्। मनष्यलोके विख्यातां गिरिशृङ्गविदारणीम्॥
en: It inspired the enemies with terror and the friends with joy. It was celebrated in the world and capable or riving mountain summits.

sa: शूरबाहुविसृष्टानां शक्तीनां भरतर्षभ। ज्योतिषामिव सम्पातमपश्यन् कुरुपाण्डवाः॥
en: Both the Kurus and the Pandavas, O foremost of Bharatas, saw the darts, shot off heroic arms, pass like meteors through the sky.

sa: संरक्ष्यमाणं भार्याभिरनुरक्ताभिरच्युत। भीषयन्त्यो विकर्षन्ति गहनं निम्नमन्तिकात्॥
en: See, O Achyuta, carnivorous creatures are dragging his body away to a neighbouring jungle, though his devoted wives are trying to protect it.

sa: ददौ पशुपतिस्तस्मै सर्वभूतमहाचमूम्॥ उग्रां नानाप्रहरणां तपोवीर्यबलान्विताम्।
en: Shiva gave him a large army, highly dreadful and armed with various kinds of weapons and endued with great energy of ascetic penances.

sa: भीष्म उवाच स्वराष्ट्रात् परराष्ट्राच्च कोशं संजनयेन्नृपः। कोशाद्धि धर्मः कौन्तेय राज्यमूलं च वर्धते॥
en: Bhishma said By taking riches from his own kingdom as also from the kingdoms of his enemies, the king should, replenish his treasury. Religious merit springs from the treasury, O son of Kunti, and it is through the treasury that the roots of his kingdom extend.

sa: दंष्ट्राकरलवदनं व्यादितास्यं भयानकम्। नयनानां सहस्त्रैश्च विचित्रैरभिभूषितम्॥
en: His teeth made his face terrible to look at. His mouth was open and dreadful. His face had a thousand of beautiful eyes.

sa: पाण्डुरारुणवर्णानि स्रोतांसि विमलान्यपि। सुस्रुवुर्गिरिधातुभ्यः सभस्मानि भुजंगवत्॥
en: And the waters although unstained, being mixed up with mineral substances and ashes from the mountains, flowed in serpentine torrents black and red.

sa: न चाहं यौवराज्येन सुग्रीवेणाभिषेचितः॥ नरेन्द्रेणाभिषिक्तोऽस्मि रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा।
en: And, further, I have not been installed heirapparent by Sugrīva: I have been sprinkled by that foremost of kings, Rāma of untiring energy.

sa: गङ्गायमुनयोः संधिमादाय मनुजर्षभ। कालिन्दीमनुगच्छेतां नदी पश्चान्मुखाश्रिताम्॥
en: O best of men, do you coming to the confluence of the Gangā and the Yamunā proceed along the Kalindi river flowing westwards.

sa: कदा प्राणिसहस्राणि राजमार्गे ममात्मजौ। लाजैरवकरिष्यन्ति प्रविशन्तावरिंदमौ॥
en: When will people by thousands shower fried paddy upon my sons on the road, as those repressors of foes will enter the city?

sa: धात्र्यास्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा कुब्जा क्षिप्रममर्षिता। कैलासशिखराकारात्प्रासादादवरोहत॥
en: Hearing the words of the nurse, the humpbacked one, speedily growing angry, descended from the edifice resembling a summit of the Kailasa hill.

sa: तस्यास्तान्यग्निवर्णानि भूषणानि महीतले। सघोषाण्यवशीर्यन्त क्षीणास्तारा इवाम्बरात्॥
en: And like stars of exhausted religious merit dropping down from the sky, her fiery ornaments began to fall to the earth with sounds.

sa: तस्य निष्कृष्यमाणस्य बाणस्यापि बभौ द्युतिः॥ अस्तमस्तकसंरुद्धरश्मेदिनकरादिव।
en: There beamed the shaft extracted from his body like to the rays of the Sun, stationed on the summit of the setting hill.

sa: उद्विग्नः शङ्कितश्चाहं विचरामि महावने। अनुरक्तैः सहामात्यैर्हनुमत्प्रमुखैवरैः॥
en: And exercised with fear and anxiety, therefore, I have been wandering in this mighty forest along with my devoted counsellors, headed by Hanumān.

sa: बहुश्रुतानां वृद्धानां ब्राह्मणानामुपासिता। तेनास्येहातुला कीर्तिर्यशस्तेजश्च वर्धते॥
en: He ministers to variously-versed aged Brāhmaṇas. It is for this that in this world his fame and renown and energy go on increasing.

sa: ततः काञ्चनशैलाभस्तरुणार्कनिभाननः। अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः॥
en: Thereupon Hanuman, the son of Marut, resembling a golden hill and having a countenance resembling the rising Sun, spoke with folded hands, saying.

sa: सुमन्त्रश्चापि शत्रुघ्नमुत्थाप्याभिप्रसाद्य च। श्रावयामास तत्त्वज्ञः सर्वभूतभवाभवौ॥
en: And Sumantra also versed in the nature of things, raising up Šatrughna and pacifying him, discoursed the birth and heath of all beings.

sa: दृष्टोमयाऽऽश्रमः सौम्य बह्वाश्चर्यः कृतात्मनाम्। विश्वस्तमृगशार्दूलो नानाविहगसेवितः॥
en: Beheld have I, O gentle one, the wondrous asylum of the pure-souled ascetics filled with diverse birds and tigers rambling friendly with antelopes.

sa: द्वीपस्तस्यापरे पारे शतयोजनविस्तृतः॥ अगम्यो मानुषैर्दीप्तस्तं मार्गध्वं समन्ततः। तत्र सर्वात्मना सीता मार्गितव्या विशेषतः॥
en: On its other shore is an island extending over an hundred Yojanas, inaccessible to men*, and of splendid aspect. Do you explore it all round. There, in particular, you must every way search for Sita. *Because, says the commentator,. of the profusion of gold in it.

sa: पश्य मेघघनप्रख्यं मृगपक्षिसमाकुलम्॥ मतङ्गवनमित्येव विश्रुतं रघुनन्दन।
en: Do you behold, O Rāghava, this forest, crowded with deer and birds resembling a dense cloud. This forest is known as Matanga's wood.

sa: मातङ्गयूथानुसृतं पक्षिसंघानुनादितम्। चित्रकूटमिमं पश्य प्रवृद्धशिखरं गिरिम्॥
en: Do you behold Citrakuta frequented by mad elephants and resonant with the voice of multitudes of birds, the mountain with its towering summits.

sa: कथाभिरभिरामाभिरभिरामौ नृपात्मजौ। रमयामास धर्मात्मा कौशिको मुनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: And that foremost of ascetics, the righteoussouled son of Kuśika, by means of his excellent converse, charmed the prepossessing sons of the monarch.

sa: सत्कारं समनुप्राप्य कथाभिरभिरञ्जयन्॥ यथार्हमजपन् संध्यामृषयस्ते समाहिताः।
en: Having experienced their hospitality, they (the guests) delighted them with their talk. And then the saints with collected minds recited their evening prayers.

sa: विश्वामित्रो हि राजर्षिर्हष्टपुष्टस्तदाभवत्। सान्तःपुरवरो राजा सब्राह्मणपुरोहितः॥
en: And the royal saint, Viśvāmitra himself, together with the priests and Brāhmaṇas and the inmates of the inner apartment, was also heartily filled.

sa: आत्मैव स्थानं मम जन्म चात्मा ओतप्रोतोऽहमजरप्रतिष्ठः। अजश्चरो दिवारात्रमतन्द्रितोऽहं मां विज्ञाय कविरास्ते प्रसन्नः॥
en: The soul is my place and the soul is my birth, I am both the warp and the woof; I am established on that which is in destructible. Though without birth, I roam about in full consciousness, day and night; knowing me wise men become satisfied.

sa: तमाहुः पार्थिवाः सर्वे दीप्यमानमिव श्रिया। को भवान् कस्य वा बन्धुर्देशस्य नगरस्य वा॥
en: The Royal Rishi Yayati, after all his religious merit had been spent up, fell among them; all the rulers of the earth said to him who was effulgent with beauty. “Who are you? With whom are you related, and from what town and country are you?

sa: अवमेने नरान् सर्वान् देवानृषिगणांस्तथा। ययातिर्मूढविज्ञानो विस्मयाविष्टचेतनः॥
en: Yayati, with his senses stupefied and his intellect beside himself, insulted all the human beings and the gods and the body of Rishis.

sa: ततः स्वरथमास्थाय जाम्बूनदविभूषितम्। सहास्माभिर्निववृते राधेयो दीनमानसः॥
en: Then having seated himself on his own car bedecked with gold he returned in company with his own followers, with a sad heart.

sa: वसिष्ठवामदेवाभ्यां विप्रैश्चान्यैः सहस्रशः। पौरजानपदैः सार्धं रामानयनकाझया।॥
en: Vasishtha, Vamadeva, thousands of other Brahmanas and the people of the cities and the provinces, with an eager desire to bring Rama back.

sa: तयोासीत् सुतुमुलः सम्प्रहारः सुदारुणः। नखदन्तायुधवतोाघ्योरिव दृप्तयोः॥
en: They having nails and teeth for their weapon, there arose a fierce and great encounter between them like that between two maddened tigers.

sa: देवारण्यान्यतिक्रम्य पर्वतांश्च बहूंस्ततः। हिमवन्तमतिक्रम्य उत्तरं पार्श्वमागमत्॥
en: Having gone through many forests of the gods and many mountains and having crossed the Himavat, the northern side was reached by them.

sa: शैनेयोऽयं चेदयश्चान्धकाश्च वार्ष्णेयभोजाः कुकुरा: संजयाश्च। उपासीना वासुदेवस्य बुद्धिं निगृह्य शत्रून् सुहृदो नन्दयन्ति॥
en: This Shini and the king of the Chedis and the king of the Andhakas and of the Vrishnis, of the Bhojas, of the Kukuras and of the Srinjayas, all by following the counsels of the son of Vasudeva slay their enemies and thus please their friends.

sa: तमुवाचाथ स मुनिर्गच्छावः सहिताविति। सलिलेशदिदृक्षार्थमहमप्युद्यतो दिवः॥
en: Then the Muni said to him, "We both shall go together." To see the god of the waters I too come down heaven.

sa: सर्वे च येऽन्ये धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रा बलप्रधाना निगमप्रदधानाः। स्थिताश्च धर्मेषु तथा स्वकेषु लोकप्रवीराः श्रुतकालवृद्धाः॥
en: And (with) also all the other sons of Dhritarashtra who have under their command the best army and a thorough knowledge of politics, who adhere to virtue, who are heroes among men and who know the meaning of the Vedas and the signs of the times.

sa: निकृत्तेषु ततस्तेषु निष्क्रामन्नण्डजास्त्वथा कपिञ्जलास्तित्तिराश्च कलविङ्काश्च सर्वशः।॥
en: The heads, being cut off, came out from them a good many birds of the Kapinjala, (doves) Titara (sparrows) and Kalavinka (parrots) species.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्दुर्योधनममर्षणम्। निश्चक्राम ततः शुभ्राद् धार्तराष्ट्रनिवेशनात्॥
en: The one of long arms, thus speaking to the wrathful Duryodhana, then came away from the white mansion of the son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: वीरौ तावभिसंरब्धौ संनिकृष्टौ महाभुजौ। छादयेतां शरव्रातैरन्योन्यमपराजितौ॥
en: Worked up with anger those two longarmed heroes, confronting each other, and each capable of vanquishing the other, covered each other with arrows.

sa: एताश्चान्याश्च दीप्ताक्ष्यः करभोत्कटमूर्द्धजाः। परिवार्यासते सीतां दिवारानमतन्द्रिताः॥
en: These and other (Rakshasas) females with flaming eyes and hair stiff as that of a camel, surrounded Sita very watchfully day and night.

sa: ईदृशेऽत्यर्थकृच्छ्रेऽस्मिन् कमन्यं मधुसूदन। उपसम्प्रष्टुमर्हामि त्वामृते पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: In such a difficulty whom other, 0 slayer of Madhu, but yourself is it proper for us to consult, O best among men.

sa: प्रलम्बबाहूरुकरजवान्तरविलम्बिनाम्। ऋक्षाणां धूम्रवर्णानां तिस्रः कोट्यो व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: Thirty millions of grey-coloured bears having long arms and thighs, broad paws and supporting themselves on their broad haunches prepared themselves (for battle).

sa: गच्छन्ति मया रथपदातयः। देवासुराणां भावानामहमेकः प्रवर्तिता॥
en: Cars and infantry can go over waters solidified by me. I am the only director of the affairs of the gods and Asuras.

sa: तावुभौ गार्धपत्राभ्यां निशिताभ्यां धनंजयः। विद्ध्वा युगपदव्यग्रस्तयोर्वाहानसूदयत्॥
en: Not the least excited Dhananjaya simultaneously struck both of them with a pair of sharp arrows and destroyed the horses of the both.

sa: अभिषिक्तस्य कौन्तेयो धारयिष्यति मूर्धनि। किङ्किणीशतनिर्घोषं वैयाघ्रपरिवारणम्॥
en: Hold over your head the big white umbrella; and your chariot so ringing with a hundred tinkling bells and covered with tiger skins,

sa: तावुभौ ख्याकर्माणावुभौ वायुसमौ जवे। उभौ दिव्यास्त्रविदुषावुभावुत्तमतेजसौ।
en: Both of them were equally illustrious and equal to the wind in speed, equally conversant with celestials weapons and gifted with great energy.

sa: द्रौपदेया महेष्वासाः सुवर्णविकृतध्वजाः। धृष्टद्युम्नमुखा द्रोणमभियास्यन्ति भारत।॥
en: The mighty bowmen, the of Draupadi, having their flag ornamented with gold, with Dhrishtadyumna at their head, will fight with Drona, O Bharata.

sa: तावाद्रवन्तौ संक्रुद्धौ वलावेगप्रमाथिनौ। अभिजग्राह सौमित्रिर्विनियोभौ पतत्रिभिः॥
en: Seeing Vajravega and Pramathin advance against him in great wrath, the son of Sumitra with a loud shout assailed them both with shafts.

sa: सम्भोगसंविद् विषमोऽतिमानी दत्तानुतापी कृपणो बलीयान्। वर्गप्रशंसी वनितासु द्वेष्टा एते परे सप्त नृशंसवर्गाः॥
en: He who considers enjoyment to be a grand aim of life, he who repents after making a gift, he who is a miser, he who oppresses others, he who is pleased at the misery of others and he who hates his wife-these seven are extremely wicked.

sa: यः पाण्डवानेकरथेन वीरः समुत्सहत्यप्रधृष्यान् विजेतुम्। यो मुह्यतां मोहयिताद्वितीयो वैकर्तनः कुशलं तस्य पृच्छेः॥
en: The heroes, who above from his car, excepts to defeat the sons of Pandu who are hard to vanquish, the one who is without a rival in de-fooling the fools (sons of Dhritarashtra) viz., (Karna) the son of Vaikartana should also be asked concerning his health.

sa: धनेनाधर्मलब्धेन यच्छिद्रमपिधीयते। असंवृतं तद् भवथि ततोऽन्यदवदीर्यते॥
en: The hole, that one seeks to stop by wealth acquired by foul means, remains uncovered; and others come into existence in other places.

sa: अध्यर्धकायसंपन्नमितरेणाप्रकाशता। स पुत्रः क्रोधसंरब्धः शशापैनामिति श्रुतिः॥
en: As an embryo with the upper part developed, but the lower part undeveloped. Thereupon the child grew angry and cursed its mother, saying,

sa: अश्रौषमहमूरुस्थो गर्भशय्यागतस्तदा। आरावं मातृवर्गस्य भृगूणां क्षत्रियैर्वधे॥
en: When I was lying unborn within my mother and other women of the Bhrigu race as they were being massacred by the Kshatriyas.

sa: तामेकवसनां दृष्ट्वा गौतमोऽप्सरसं वने। लोकेऽप्रतिमसंस्थानां प्रोत्फुल्लनयनोऽभवत्॥
en: Seeing that Apsara of matchless beauty on earth clad in a single cloth (roaming) alone in that wood, Gautama's eyes danced in delight.

sa: आवृण्वानं महाज्वालमर्चिभिः सर्वतोऽम्बरम्। दहन्तमिव तीक्ष्णांशुं चण्डवायुसमीरितम्॥
en: The terrible flames of that fire covered whole of the sky and moved by violent winds, they bent on burning the very sun.

sa: जातकर्माण्यानुपूर्व्याच्चूडोपनयनानि च। चकार विधिवद् धौम्यस्तेषां भरतसत्तम॥
en: O king, all their rites of infancy and childhood according to the ordinance, such as Chudakarana and Upanayana, were duly performed by Dhaumya.

sa: ऊचुश्च कूर्मराजानमकूपारे सुरासुराः। अधिष्ठानं गिरेरस्य भवान्भवितुमर्हति॥
en: The Devas and the Danavas then went to the Tortoise king and said, “You will have to support the mountain on your back.”

sa: ततो देवाः प्रयातास्ते विमानैर्बहुविस्तरैः। रामोऽप्यनुजगामाशु कुम्भयोनेस्तपोवनम्॥
en: And having ascended spacious cars the celestials proceeded to the hermitage of Agastya born of a Kumbha. Rāma too also followed i them.

sa: अध्यात्मयोगनिद्रां च पद्मनाभस्य सेवतः। युगादिकालशयनं विष्णोरमिततेजसः॥
en: It became the bed of lotus-navelled Vishnu when at the end of every Yuga the immeasurably powerful Deity fell asleep in spiritual meditation.

sa: पृथोर्वैन्यस्य यत्रोक्तमाख्यानं परमर्षिणा। संवादश्च सरस्वत्यास्तायर्षेः सुमहात्मनः॥
en: The story of Pritha, the son of Vena, was told by the Rishi; also the debate of Sarasvati and that of Rishi Tarkshya.

sa: जमदग्नेस्तु चत्वार आसन्पुत्रा महात्मनः। रामस्तेषां जघन्योऽभूदजघन्यैर्गुणैर्युतः॥
en: The illustrious Jamadagni had four sons, the youngest of them was Parshurama. He was superior to all his other brothers in good qualities.

sa: अभिश्च मन्युमांश्चैव ततस्तमरिमर्दनम्। अभिमन्युमिति प्राहुरार्जुनि पुरुषर्षभम्॥
en: That best of the Bharata race, that chastiser of foes, that son of Arjuna, was called Abhimanyu, because he was fearless and wrathful.

sa: दमघोषसुतो धीरः शिशुपालो महामतिः। धनुरादायमानस्तु जानुभ्यामगमन्महीम्॥
en: The high-souled and determined son of Damaghosha, Shishupala, attempted to string the bow, but he himself fell on his knees on the ground.

sa: रूपलक्षणसम्पन्नां शीलाचारसमन्विताम्। द्रौपदीमवदत् प्रेम्णा पृथाऽऽशीवर्चनं स्नुषाम्॥
en: Out of affection Pritha (Kunti) pronounced a blessing on Draupadi, endued with beauty and auspicious marks and with sweet disposition and good character.

sa: दुपदश्चैव राजर्षिस्तत एवाभवद्गणात्। मानुषे नृपलोकेऽस्मिन्सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: That royal sage, king Drupada, the best of all the wielder of arms, was also born the portions of the same celestials (Marutas).

sa: एतत्सुबहुवृत्तांतमुत्तमं चानुशासनम्। भीष्यस्यात्रैव संप्राप्तिः स्वर्गस्य परिकीर्तिता॥
en: All these excellent matters have been treated in this Anushasana Parva containing variety of incidents. It also describes ascension of Bhishma to heaven.

sa: रूपवान् वीर्यसम्पन्नः श्रीमानतुलविक्रमः। नित्यं दीक्षाङ्किततनुः शतक्रतुरिवापरः॥
en: He was handsome, mighty, wealthy and matchlessly powerful. He always bore (sacrificial) marks on his person and looked like a second Shakra (Indra).

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवस्ताम्रविस्फारितेक्षणः। रथप्रतिमुखं रामं सायकैरवधूनयत्॥
en: Thereat the Ten-necked one, enraged, with his eyes coppery and dilated (in passion), covered with arrows Rāma staying in front of his car.

sa: सान्त्वयित्वा प्रकृतयस्ततो राममुपागमत्। दध्यक्षतान्मोदकांश्च लाजाः सुमनसस्तथा॥
en: And consoling his subjects he went to Rāma. And the monkey citizens, delighted, brought him curd, fried grain, sweetmeats, fried paddy and flowers.

sa: राक्षसा विस्मयं जग्मुः सहसाभिनिपीडिताः। वानरैर्मेघसंकाशैः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः॥
en: The Rākşasas, sore pressed by thousands of monkeys resembling masses of clouds, and like to Śakra himself in battle, were seized with amazement.

sa: आकाशाद्विधनात्तीव्रादुल्मुकान्यपतंस्तदा। वमन्तः पावकज्वालाः शिवा घोरा ववाशिरे॥
en: From the cloudless yet fierce sky meteors began to shoot. and throwing up flames from their mouths, dreadful jackals began to emit cries.

sa: शयानः शरतल्पेऽस्मिन्सशोणितपरिसुतः। शरभूतस्ततो भासि भास्करोऽस्तमिव व्रजन्॥
en: And lying down in the battle-field, bleeding and covered with arrows, you appear like the Sun when he has gone up the Setting-hill.

sa: पुलस्त्य इति विज्ञाय वचनाद्धैहयाधिपः। शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय प्रत्युद्गच्छत्तपस्विनम्॥
en: Understanding from their words that Pulastya was coming, the king of Haihayas, placing his folded palms on his crown, proceeded to welcome him.

sa: ते गदामुसलप्रासैः शक्तितोमरमुद्गरैः। अभिघ्नन्तस्तदा यक्षा राक्षसान्समुपाद्रवन्।४।।
en: And attacking the Rākşasas with maces and clubs and bearded darts, and with darts tomoras and bludgeons, the Yaksas rushed at (their adversaries).

sa: अद्य शोकपरीतानां स्वबन्धुवधशोचिनाम्। शत्रोर्युधि विनाशेन करोम्यश्रुप्रमार्जनम्॥
en: Today shall I slaying the enemies in battle, wipe the tears of those who mourn their friend slain and are overwhelmed with grief.

sa: तस्मादुत्सृज्य वैक्लव्यं सर्वकार्यविनाशनम्। हितं रामपुरोगाणां सैन्यानामनुचिन्तय॥
en: Therefore, casting off stupor, which tends to mar all work, do you bethink you how you may serve this army headed by Rāma.

sa: सहसाभिहतस्तेन विप्रमुक्तपदः स्फुरन्। निपपात त्रिकूटाभो विह्वलन्प्लवगोत्तमः॥
en: Suddenly wounded with it, that best of monkeys having the splendour of Trikūța, fell down senseless to the earth, stretching his legs wide.

sa: निर्धूतपत्रशिखराः शीर्णपुष्पफलद्रुमाः। निक्षिप्तवस्त्राभरणा धूर्ता इव पराजिताः॥
en: With their leaves and tops torn, and their flowers and fruits shrivelled up, the trees looked like worsted gamblers bereft of their clothes.

sa: घनान्धकारे तिमिरे शिलावर्षमिवाद्भुतम्। स ववर्ष महाबाहुर्नाराचशरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: In that terrible darkness of clouds that one of mighty arms began to make a downpour of Nāracas and arrows like hail storms.

sa: अतिकायोऽतितेजस्वी राक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्तदा। आरुरोह रथश्रेष्ठं श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥ सुचक्राक्षं सुसंयुक्तं सानुकर्ष सकूबरम्। तूणीबाणासनैर्दीप्तं प्रासासिपरिघाकुलम्॥
en: Then that foremost of all bowmen-the powerful Atikāya-son to the lord of Raksasas-ascended the best of cars, having excellent wheels and akşas, and yoked with excellent steeds, and furnished with bottoms and holes; flaming with quivers and bows; and bristling with prāścas and swords and blugdeons.

sa: मार्गमाणो वरारोहां राजपुत्रीमनिन्दिताम्। सुखप्रसुप्तान् विहगान्बोधयामास वानरः॥
en: As he was searching for that surpassingly beautiful and blameless daughter of the king, that monkey awakened the monkeys that were sleeping sweetly..

sa: तस्य तच्छुशुभे भूयः सशरं धनुरुत्तमम्। विद्युदैरावतार्चिष्माद्दितीयेन्द्रधनुर्यथा॥
en: And his excellent bow with shafts shone resplendent like the very bow of Indra himself affluent with the splendour of Airāvata and lightning.

sa: तत्र चाग्निपरीतानि निपेतुर्भवनान्यपि॥ वज्रिवज्रहतानीव शिखराणि महागिरेः।
en: Consumed by the fire, buildings began to drop down like the summits of a mighty mountain smite with the thunder-bolt of the thunderer.

sa: न तु धर्मोपसंहारमधर्मफलसंहितम्। तदेव फलमन्वेति धर्मश्चाधर्मनाशनः॥
en: He that, confiding in his strength, commit himself to foul proceedings, cannot count upon his righteous deeds, but his evil ones follow him.

sa: प्रधावनुरुवेगेन बभञ्ज तरसा दुमान् । हनूमान्परमनुद्धश्चरणैर्दारयन्महीम्॥
en: Thereat rushing a main vehemently (Akampana) speedily broke the trees. And (seeing this) Hanumān, transported with passion, rived the earth with his kicks.

sa: अद्यैव त्रिदशान्सर्वान्विक्रमैः समरे स्वयम्। नानाशस्त्रमहासारैर्नयामि यमसादनम्॥
en: I shall soon in the field of battle, with the stroke of various weapons despatch all the deities to the abode of Death,

sa: अब्रवीच्च स तान्सर्वान्बलमुख्यान्महाबलः। रावणः प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं पुत्रव्यसनकर्शितः॥
en: And stricken with grief in consequence of his son's death, that highly powerful Ravana, with folded hands, addressed all the heroic Rākşasas saying.

sa: स रराज रथे तस्मिन्राजसूनुर्महाबलः। वृतो नैऋतशार्दूलर्वज्रपाणिरिवामरैः॥
en: That powerful son of the kind surrounded by the Naiſtas looked lovely on that car like the thunder-handed (Deity) engirt by the immortals.

sa: राजन्परिघशक्त्यष्टिशूलपट्टिशकुन्तलम्॥ सुमहन्नो बलं कस्माद्विषादं भजते भवान्।
en: You have, o king, enough of soldiers and various types of weapons like parighas saktis etc. Why are you smitten with sorrow then?

sa: इति संचिन्त्य मनसा च्छायामस्य समाक्षिपत्॥ छायायां गृह्यमाणायां चिन्तयामास वानरः। समाक्षिप्तोऽस्मि सहसा पङ्गकृतपराक्रमः॥ प्रतिलोमेन वातेन महानौरिव सागरे। तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधश्चैव वीक्षमाणस्तदा कपिः॥ ददर्श स महासत्त्वमुत्थितं लवणाम्भसि।
en: Having thought thus in her mind, she seized (Hanumān's) shadow. On his shadow* Brahmā had conferred on her a boon that she should secure her prey by pulling at it by means of its shadow.— "As a mighty bark is retarded in its course in the sea by adverse wind, have I, my prowess paralysed, been suddenly obstructed in my career.” Then looking above and below and sideways, the monkey saw a mighty creature arisen from the salt waters. *i.e. of securing his shadow.-being secured, the monkey reflected.

sa: कर्णिकारवनैर्दीप्तैः कदम्बवकुलैस्तथा। पद्मिनीभिश्च फुल्लाभिर्मन्दाकिन्या जलैरपि॥ चम्पकाशोकपुंनागमन्दारतरुभिस्तथा। चूतपाटललोधैश्च प्रियङ्ग्वर्जुनकेतकैः॥ तगरैनारिकेरैश्च प्रियालपनसैस्तथा। एतैरन्यैश्च तरुभिरुद्भासितवानान्तरे॥
en: The interior of the forest was beautified with the brilliant groves of Karņikār, with Kadamba and Vakula trees, groves of full blown lotuses, the waters of Mandākini, with Campaka, Asoka, Punnaga, Mandāra, mangoe, Pātala, Lodhra, Priyangu, Arjuna, Ketka, Tagara, Coconut, Pyāla, Panasa and various other trees.

sa: स तामसितकेशान्तां सुश्रोणी संहतस्तनीम्। दिदृक्षुरसितापाङ्गीमुपावर्तत रावणः॥
en: Rāvana proceeded in that way, being anxious to behold the blue-eyed Sītā, having spacious breast, excellent hips and a lock of black hair.

sa: सोऽभ्युपेत्य शरान्खङ्गान्पट्टिशासिपरश्वधान्। अभ्यवर्षत दुर्धर्षः कपिमूर्धनि राक्षसः॥
en: And rushing forward, that irrepressible one the Rākşasas-began to shower on the monkey's head arrows and swords and pațțišas and scimitars and axes.

sa: आससाद च लक्ष्मीवान् राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम्। प्राकारेणार्कवर्णेन भास्वरेणाभिसंवृतम्॥
en: And (at length) that auspicious one arrived at the mansion of the Rākṣasa chief, surrounded by a shining wall hued like the Sun;

sa: तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्। प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत।॥
en: Tama is born of ignorance, and therefore it deludes all embodied selves. O Bharata, it binds the Self with error, indolence, and sleep.

sa: ततः शक्तिगदाखङ्गत्तोमरष्टिंपरश्वधैः। कलिङ्गाश्च ततो राजन् भीमसेनमवाकिरन्॥
en: O king, armed with darts and maces and swords and lances and scimitars and battleaxes, the Kalingas by hundreds and thousands surrounded Bhimasena.

sa: सादिनां भुजगैश्छिन्नैः पतितैः साङ्गदैस्तथा। प्रासैश्च विमलैस्तीक्ष्णैर्विमलाभिस्तथर्टिभिः॥
en: With served arms of horse soldiers, adorned with bracelets and scattered about, with well polished lances of keep points and with resplendent swords,

sa: सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च तेषां गोप्ता महारथा धृष्टद्युम्नस्ततः पश्चात्यञ्चालैरभिरक्षितः॥
en: Then Satyaki and Chekitana, each a mighty car-warrior, became the protector of these last named. Behind them came Dhrishtadyumna protected by the Panchalas.

sa: प्रादुरासन् हर्षयन्तः सौभद्रमपलायिनम्। तन्नामृष्यन्त पुत्रास्ते शात्रोविजयलक्षणम्॥
en: Arose there, imparting delight to the unreceding son of Subhadra. But your sons could not tolerate these indications of victory of their adversaries;

sa: शरशक्तिगदाभिस्ते खड्नेश्चामिततेजसः। निजघ्नुः समरेऽन्योन्यं शूराः परिघबाहवः॥
en: Heroes of immeasurable prowess possessed of arms resembling bludgeons, slew one another in that battle, with shafts and Shaktis and maces and swords.

sa: परिधावद्भिरश्वैश्च वायुवेगविकम्पितम्॥ अपारमिव गर्जन्तं सागरप्रतिमं महत्।
en: The running vehicles constitute the wind that lashes that ocean into fury. It really resembles the extensive and scoreless sea roaring (in fury).

sa: नानाधातुविचित्राणि कार्मुकाणि महात्मनाम्। विस्फारितान्यदृश्यन्त तोयदेष्विव विद्युतः॥
en: The excellent bows stretched by these great warriors were of different colour and shapes. Those were appeared as if lightening in the clouds.

sa: तावुभौ बलसम्पन्नौ निस्त्रिशवरधारिणौ। निस्त्रिशाभ्यां सुतीक्ष्याभ्यामन्योन्यं संततक्षतुः॥
en: Then those two (heroes) endued with strength and armed with swords of excellent make, began to smite one another with their well-sharpened weapons.

sa: एतद् धनमपर्याप्तमश्वमेधे महामखे। शशबिन्दुमहाभागो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ह्यमन्यत॥
en: This uncountable wealth was gifted by the prosperous and respected king Sasabindu to Brahmins in the great offering Ashvamedha arranged once by him.

sa: मुहूर्तं चिन्तयामास बाष्पशोकसमाकुलः। ततः कृत्वा विधिं सर्वं शिविरस्य यथाविधि। प्रदध्यौ शोकसंतप्तो भ्रातृव्यसनकर्शितः॥
en: Reflected for moments, whelmed with tears and grief. Then making all the necessary arrangements for his camp according to the rules of military sciences he began to mediate, afflicted (as he was with) the death of his brother and overcome with poignant grief on their account.

sa: श्रुतकर्माणमायान्तं मयूरसदृशैर्हयैः। चैत्रसेनिर्महाराज तव पौत्रं न्यवारयत्॥
en: O mighty monarch, the son of Chitrasena resisted your grandson Shrutakarman, as the latter rushed at (Drona), being drawn by steeds resembling peacocks.

sa: आटरूषकवर्णाभा हयाः पाण्ड्यानुयायिनाम्। अवहन् रथमुख्यानामयुतानि चतुर्दश॥
en: Steeds of the hue of the Atarusha flower bore one thousand and forty thousand foremost car-warrior who followed that king of the Pandya.

sa: आहोस्विच्छकटव्यूहं प्रविष्टा मोघनिश्चयाः। द्रोणमाश्रित्य तिष्ठन्तं प्राकारमकुतोभयम्॥
en: Or did all of them, forgetting their determination, enter into the Sakata array and stood behind the fearless Drona resembling a solid wall?

sa: आत्मनिःश्रेयसं सर्वे प्राप्तकालं महाबलाः। मन्त्रयामासुरव्यग्रा मन्त्रनिश्चयकोविदाः॥
en: The highly powerful heroes, accomplished in drawing conclusion from inferences, coolly consulted about what would be most profitable to them under these circumstances.

sa: ततः परमधर्मात्मा दिष्टान्तमुपजग्मिवान्। एतावदेव निवृत्तमस्माकं शोकवर्धनम्॥
en: That one of highly illustrious soul through Destiny, attained his own end. Thus everything that now burns us with grief, has taken place.

sa: आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्कोतिषां रविरंशुमान्। मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी॥
en: I am Vishnu amongst the Adityas, all resplendent Sun among all shining bodies. I am Marichi among Maruts, and the Moon among constellations.

sa: तत्राभिमन्युः संक्रुद्धो द्रौपदेयाश्च मारिष। विव्यधुनिशितैर्बाणैः सर्वांस्तानुद्यतायुधान्॥
en: Then, O sire, Abhimanyu waxing worth, and the sons of Draupadi also, pierced with their whetted shafts all those warriors with uplifted weapons.

sa: तस्मिन्नतिमहाभीमे सेनयोर्क पराक्रमे। सम्प्रधावत्स्वनीकेषु मेदिनी समकम्पत।॥
en: Then when the fighters of the two hosts rushed impetuously against one another in thai terrible combat, the earth shook underneath their tread.

sa: अक्षोभ्योऽयमभेद्यश्च भीष्मेणामित्रकर्षिणा। कल्पितः शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना भूरिवर्चसा॥
en: Immovable and impenetrable in this Vyuha, formed according to the rules of the Shastras, by that chastiser of foes, Bhishma of unfading glory.

sa: शिश्नोदरकृतेऽप्राज्ञः करोति विघसं बहु। मोहरागवशाक्रान्त इन्द्रियार्थवशानुगः॥
en: Move by ignorance and passions and becoming slaves to their senses, ignorant men perform many acts to gratify their stomachs an sexual organs.

sa: मधुसूदनमित्याहुर्ऋषयश्च जनार्दनम्॥ वराहश्चैव सिंहश्च त्रिविक्रमगतिः प्रभुः।
en: And the sages call Janardana by the name of the Slayer of Madhu. The great Boar, the Lion and the three treaded Lord.

sa: अनुलोमानिलैश्चाशु प्रदर्शितजयोदयः। भीमसेनो महाबाहुः कवची शुभकुण्डली॥
en: Auspicious winds began to blow indicating his success in the coming encounter. Then the mighty-armed Bhimasena covered with armour, graced with beautiful ear-rings.

sa: अद्भ्यः स्तोका यान्ति यथा पृथक्त्वं ताभिश्चैक्यं संक्षये यान्ति भूयः। एवं विद्वान् प्रभवं चाप्ययं च मत्वा भूतानां तव सायुज्यमेति॥
en: Time, Brahma and the Vedas and the Brahmanas and all the mobile and immobile creatures have all sprung from you. Vapours rising up from expanses of water are turned into rain drops and which falling upon the earth, are separated from one another. When the hour of the universal dissolution comes, those separated individual drops once more : unite together and make the earth one vast sheet of water.

sa: तत: प्रवीराः पाण्डूनामभ्यधावन्नमर्षिताः। युधिष्ठिरं परीप्सन्तः कर्णमभ्यर्दयञ्छरैः॥
en: Then to rescue the king many leading Pandava warriors fell upon Karna in great anger and began to assail him with their arrows.

sa: निनदद्भिर्भूशायस्तै राश्वद्विरदोत्तमैः॥ पतितैरभवत् कीर्णा मेदिनी भरतर्षभ।
en: The Earth, O Chief of Bharata was covered with the bodies of foremost of men, and horses and elephants huddled together and bewailing.

sa: अप्रत्यक्षं बहुद्वारं धर्ममाश्रमवासिनाम्। प्ररूपयन्ति तद्भावमागमैरेव शाश्वतम्॥
en: The duties of men are not clear. They have, again, many exceptions. Guided by many (false) systems, their true nature is sometimes spoiled.

sa: त्वं पुष्कराक्षस्त्वरविन्दवक्त्रः सहस्रवक्त्रोऽसि सहस्रबाहुः। त्वं लोकपालः परमं हविश्व त्वं भावनः सर्वसुरासुराणाम्॥
en: You are lotus-eyed, you possess a lotus-like face, you have one thousand faces and one thousand arms. You are the ruler of the universe and you are the great oblations, you are the animating spirit of all the celestials and the Asuras.

sa: असिमुद्गरहस्ताश्च दण्डहस्ताश्च भारत॥ गदाभुशुण्डिहस्ताश्च तथा तोमरपाणयः। आयुधैविविधैोरैर्महात्मानो महाजवाः॥ महाबलाः महावेगा महापारिषदास्तथा।
en: Some, huge-bodied and powerful combatants, were armed with lances and scimitars. Some were armed with maces and Bhushundis and some had spears on their hands. The powerful, noble and energetic and quick-coursing companions had various kinds of terrible weapons in their arins.

sa: अधर्मो धर्म इत्येतद् यथा वृकपदं तथा॥ धर्माधर्मफले जातु ददर्शेह न कश्चन।
en: As it is useless, upon seeing certain footprints on the ground, to argue, whether they are the wolf's or not, is all discussion regarding the nature of righteousness and unrighteousness. Nobody in this world ever witnesses the fruits of righteousness and unrighteousness.

sa: बहुकथितमिदं हि बुद्धिमद्भिः कविभिरपि प्रथयद्भिरात्मकीर्तिम्। इदमिदमिति तत्र तत्र हन्त स्वपरमतैर्गहनं प्रतर्कषद्भिः॥
en: Learned and highly intelligent men, desirous of giving a publicity to their own feats, have while supporting their own theories and censuring those of others, indulged in vague expressions in delivering themselves on the topic which is beyond the scope of argumentation.

sa: भविष्यत्येष ते कामः कुशिकात् कौशिको द्विजः। तृतीयं पुरुषं तुभ्यं ब्राह्मणत्वं गमिष्यति॥
en: I tell you that your desire will be fulfilled. From you, O Kushika, will originate a Brahmana who shall be called after your name. The person that will be the third in descent from you shall obtain the status of a Brahmana.

sa: प्रत्युद्गत इव प्रेम्णा भूम्या स नरपुङ्गवः॥ प्रियया कान्तया कान्तः पतमान इवोरसि।
en: Like a dear wife advancing to reserve her dear husband about to fall on her breast, the Earth as if, out of affection, rose a little for receiving that best of men as he fell down with wounded limbs covered with blood.

sa: दक्षस्य या वै दुहितरः षष्टिरासंस्ताभ्यः कश्यपाय त्रयोदश प्रादाद् दश धर्माय दश मनवे सप्तविंशतिमिन्दवे तासु तुल्यासु नक्षत्राख्यां गतासु सोमो रोहिण्यामभ्यधिकं प्रीतिमानभूत् ततस्ताः शिष्टाः पल्य ईर्ष्यावत्यः पितुः समीपं गन्वेममर्थं शशंसुर्भगवन्नस्मासु तुल्यप्रभावासु सोमो रोहिणी प्रत्यधिकं भजतीति सोऽब्रवीद् यक्ष्मैनमाविश्यतेति दक्षशापात् सोमं राजानं यक्ष्मा विवेश स यक्ष्मणाऽविष्टो दक्षमगाद् दक्षश्चैनमब्रवीन्न समं वर्तयसीति तत्रर्षयः सोममब्रुवन् क्षीयसे यक्ष्मणा पश्चिमायां दिशि समुद्रे हिरण्यसरस्तीर्
en: The Prajapati Daksha begat sixty daughters. Amongst them, thirteen were bestowed by him upon Kashyapa; ten upon Dharma; ten upon Manu; and twenty-seven upon Soma. Although all the the twenty-seven who called Nakshatras and conferred upon Soma were cqual in beauty and accomplishments, yet Soma became more attached to one, viz., Rohini, than the rest. Filled with jealousy, the rest of his wives, leaving him, went to their husband, saying,-O holy one, although all of us are equal in beauty, yet our husband Soma is wholly attached to our sister Rohini!-Enraged at this representation of his daughters, the celestial Rishi Daksha cursed Soma, saying, that thenceforth the disease phthisis should attach his son-in-law and live in him. Through this curse of Daksha, phthisis attacked the powerful Som

sa: एक शृङ्गः पुरा भूत्वा वराहो नन्दिवर्धनः। इमां चवोद्धृतवान् भूमिमेक शृङ्गस्ततो ह्यहम्॥
en: Putting on, in days of yore, the form of a boar with a single tusk, O increaser of the joys of others, I raised the sub-merged Earth from the bottom of the ocean. Therefore am I called by the name of Ekashringa.

sa: ददाति यः समुद्रान्तां पृथिवीं शस्त्रनिर्जिताम्। तं जनाः कथयन्तीह यावद् भवति गौरियम्॥
en: That king who gives away the Earth bounded by the ocean, after having conquered it with the help of his weapons, is talked of by all men and his memory lasts as long as the mountains last on the surface of Earth.

sa: न तेजसोऽस्ति संस्पर्शो मम देव विभावसो। आपदर्थे हि सम्बन्धः सुसूक्ष्मोऽपि महाद्युते॥
en: There has been no actual contact of my body with your seed, O illustrious deity of fire. Our union, having for its cause the distress that has befallen the celestials, has been subtile and not of the flesh, O highly effulgent one.

sa: स्त्रियश्चान्या नृसिंहानां बभूवुर्हष्टमानसाः। तत्र मला नटाश्चैव ग्रन्थिकाः सौख्यशायिकाः॥ सूतमागधसंघाश्चाप्यस्तुवंस्तं जनार्दनम्। कुरुवंशस्तवाख्याभिराशीर्भिर्भरतर्षभ॥
en: Then wrestlers and actors and astrologers and those who enquire after the sleep (of princes), and bands of bards and eulogists all uttered the praises of Janardana, while ultering benedictions filled with the praises of the Kurus, O chief of the Bharatas.

sa: कथं केभ्यश्च धर्म्य च दानं दातव्यमिष्यते। कैः कारणैः कतिविधं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: For what reasons what kinds of gifts made to what persons yield merits? Indeed, to what persons should what gifts be made? For what reasons are how many kinds of gifts to be made? I wish to hear all this in full.

sa: कोटीश्च काञ्चनस्याष्टौ प्रादां ब्रह्मन् दशान्वहम्। एकैकस्मिन् क्रतौ तेन फलेनाहं च चागतः॥
en: I gave also eight crores of golden coins to the Brahmanas, O Brahmana, and another ten crores also in each sacrifice that I celebrated. It is not, however, through the merits of those deeds that I have acquired this region of happiness.

sa: बार्हस्पत्यं वाक्यमेतन्निशम्य ये राजानो गोप्रदानानि दत्त्वा। स्तान् मे राजन् कीर्त्यमानान् निबोध॥
en: Listen to me, O king as I recite to you the names of those pious kings who have attained son to regions of great happiness as the reward of those gifts of kine which they made according to the instructions of Brihaspati.

sa: एवं मन्यामहे सर्वे भारार्ता निरपेक्षिणः। ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रो वा यधुपोषितः॥
en: Afflicted with the burthen we bear, this is what we think (beneficial for men), without the slightest selfish end. By observing this rule for full year, fasting on each occasion, Brahmanas Kshatriyas, and Vaishays and Shudras, acquire great merits from such gifts.

sa: द्यौर्नभः पृथिवी खं च तथा चैवैष भूपतिः। सर्वविद्येश्वरः श्रीमानेष चापि विभावसुः॥
en: He is Heaven, Sky, Earth, and the Welkin. He is called the Lord of the Earth. He is the Lord whose rule is acknowledged by all obstacles. He is gifted with Shree and He is at one with the God of Fire.

sa: लिङ्गैर्बहुभिरव्यौरेका बुद्धिरुपास्यते। नानालिङ्गाश्रमस्थानां येषां बुद्धिः शमात्मिका॥ ते भावमेकमायान्ति सरितः सागरं यथा।
en: With numerous unconfused symbols, only one knowledge is adored. Those who, whatever the symbols and modes of life which they follow, have acquired an understanding having tranquillity for its essence, attain to that one entity as numerous rivers all mecting the Ocean.

sa: पङ्गुष्वथ च देवर्षे ये चान्ये कुत्सिता नराः। स्त्रीणामगम्यो लोकेऽस्मिन् नास्ति कश्चिन्महामुने।।२१
en: Women may be seen to like the companionship of even those men who are inert or those men who are ugly to look at, O great Rishi, there is no man in this world whom women may consider as unfit for companionship!

sa: तथा चिरोषितं चापि सम्प्रत्यागतमेव च। अपूर्वं चैव पूर्वं च तत्पात्रं मानमर्हति॥
en: Whether the person be one who is wellknown and familiar or one who has come newly, whether he has or has not been seen before, if he happens to possess these qualifications, he should be considered as worthy of honors and hospitality.

sa: रक्षमाणैः सुसंरब्धैः पुत्रैः शस्त्रभृतां वरः। वाहिनीं प्रमुख वीरः सम्प्रकर्षन्नशोभत॥ अभ्यवर्तन्महाबाहुः सूर्यवैश्वानरप्रभः।
en: Endued with the effulgence of the moon and fire, beautiful to look at and with twany eyes, protected by his greatly angry sons, that hero, the foremost of the wielders of weapons, shone at the head of his army drawing his bow.

sa: नूनं तु तस्य तपसः सावशेषमिहास्ति वै। यदहं प्रष्टुमिच्छामि भगवन् कर्मणः फलम्॥
en: Forsooth, there is still a residue of the rewards of that penance represented by a sight of the great Hari! On account of this unspent residue that I have become desirous of asking you, O illustrious one, about the fruits of action.

sa: तथागते भीममभीस्तवात्मजः ससार राजावरजः किरशरैः। तमभ्यधावत् त्वरितो वृकोदरो महारुरुं सिंह इवाभिपोदिवान्॥
en: At that time your son Dushasana, the younger brother of the king, boldly going up to Bhimasena, shot hosts of shafts against him and Vrikodara like a lion taking his leap upon a big Ruru (deer) swiftly made a rush towards him.

sa: मेते कस्माद् विद्रवन्ते नरेन्द्राः। व्यक्तं धीमान् सव्यसाची नराग्र्यः सैन्यं ह्येतच्छादयात्याशु बाणैः॥
en: Look there and see the disbanded Bharata force! Why are all these chiefs taking to their flight. Surely it seems to me inevitable that Savyasachin, that best of human beings has been shrouding that force with a heavy downpour of his arrows.

sa: एतदर्थं महातेजा महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः॥ शरभङ्गाश्रमं पुण्यमाजगाम पुरंदरः। एतदर्थं महातेजा महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः॥
en: It is for this that the chastiser of Pāka, the great Indra, Purandra, had paid a visit to the sacred asylum of Sarabhanga. And the Maharşis had dextrously brought you to this place, for compassing the destruction of those foes-the wicked Rākşasas.

sa: मतङ्ग उवाच इदं वर्षसहस्रं वै ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। अतिष्ठमेकपादेन ब्राह्मण्यं प्राप्नुयां कथम्॥
en: Matanga said I have passed these thousand years, standing on one foot, with soul engaged in meditation and in the observance of the vow of celibacy. Why is it that I have not yet succeeded in acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana?

sa: स्वकर्मभिर्दानसंनिरुद्ध तीव्रान्धकारे नरके सम्पतन्तम्। महार्णवे नौरिव वातयुक्ता दानं गवां तारयते परत्र॥
en: A man by his own acts falls into the dark depth of the lower region infested by evil spirits, as a ship (goes down) tossed by the tempest on the high sea. But gift of kine saves him in the next world.

sa: अविद्वान् ब्राह्मणो देवः पात्रं वै पावनं महत्। विद्वान् भूयस्तरो देवः पूर्णसागरसंनिभः॥
en: Even the Brahmana who is destitute of knowledge is a god and is a great instrument for purifying others. He amongst them, then, who is possessed of knowledge is a much higher god and like the ocean when full (to the brim).

sa: शाईका ऊचुः अबर्हान् मांसभूतान् नः क्रव्यादाखुर्विनाशयेत्। पश्यमाना भयमिदं प्रवेष्टुं नाा शक्नुमः॥
en: The Sharangakas said : We are but so many balls of flesh without having our feathers. if we enter the hole, there is no doubt the carnivorous mouse will destroy us all. Seeing this fear before us, we cannot enter the hole.

sa: नैतादृशं ब्राह्मणस्यास्ति वित्तं यथैकता समता सत्यता च। शीले स्थितिर्दण्डनिधानमार्जवं ततस्ततश्चोपरमः क्रियाभ्यः॥
en: For a Brahmana there can be no wealth like living in solitude, an impartial eye for all creatures, truthfulness of speech, steady observance of good conduct, the total abandonment of the rod (of chastisement), simplicity, and the gradual abstention from all acts.

sa: भीष्म उवाच पुरा कृतयुगे तात राजा ह्यासीदकम्पनः। स शत्रुवशमापन्नः संग्रामे क्षीणवाहनः॥
en: Bhishma said In days of yore, in the Krita age, O son, there was a king of the name of Anukampaka. His cars, elephants, horse and men having been reduced in number, he succumbed to the power of his enemies in battle.

sa: एष मे निश्चयः साधो कृतं कारणमुत्तमम्। आमन्त्रयामि भद्रं ते कृतार्थोऽस्मि भुजङ्गम॥
en: I shall hence follow that yow which is so very efficacious in producing beneficial consequences. That, O blessed one, has become my certain conclusion now, based on good reasons. I take your leave. Blessing to you. My object has been done, ONaga.

sa: इदममृतपदं निशम्य राजा स्वयमिह पञ्चशिखेन भाष्यमाणम्। निखिलमभिसमीक्ष्य निश्चितार्थः परमसुखी विजहार वीतशोकः॥
en: Having heard these words capable of giving imınortality and uttered by Panchashikha, and arriving at the truth after carefully reflecting upon everything that the latter had said King Janadeva cast off his sorrows and lived on in the enjoyment of great happiness.

sa: वायोरनियमस्पर्शी वादस्थानं स्वतन्त्रता। बलं शैघ्यं च मोक्षं च कर्म चेष्टाऽऽत्मता भवः॥
en: The properties of the wind are touch that is neither hot nor cool, power to help the organs of speech, independence, strength, celerity, power to help all kinds of discharge, power to raise other objects, breaths inhaled and exhaled, life, and birth.

sa: कस्यैश्वर्यं समानं च भूतैः को वापि क्रीडते। कस्य तुल्यबला देव गणाश्चैश्वर्यदर्पिताः॥
en: Whose worship and power remains unchangeable? Who else is there who plays with spirits and ghosts. Tell me, O god, who else has companions who are possessed of strength like his own and who are, therefore, proud of that strength or power?

sa: प्रद्युम्नचारुदेष्णादीन् रुक्मिण्या वीक्ष्य पुत्रकान्। पुत्रार्थिनी मामुपेत्य वाक्यमाह युधिष्ठिर॥ शूरं बलवतां श्रेष्ठं कान्तरूपमकल्मषम्। आत्मतुल्यं मम सुतं प्रयच्छाच्युत माचिरम्॥
en: Indeed, seeing Pradyumna and Charudeshna and other sons born of Rukmini, Jamvavati, desirous of a son, said these words to me, O Yudhishthira, grant me, O you of undecaying glory, a heroic son, the foremost of powerful men, possessed of the most lovely features, sinless, and like your self. And, O, let there be no delay on your part in granting this prayer of mine!

sa: किं कार्यं ब्राह्मणेनेह मोक्षार्थश्च किमात्मकः। कथं च मोक्षः प्राप्तव्यो ज्ञानेन तपसाथवा॥
en: What are the duties of a Brahmana, and what is the essence of those duties that have Liberation for their object. How, also, is Liberation to be acquired. Is it to be acquired by the help of Knowledge or by that Penances?

sa: व्यास उवाच ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश्च वानप्रस्थोऽथ भिक्षुकः। यथोक्तचारिणः सर्वे गच्छन्ति परमां गतिम्॥
en: Vyasa said One who is a Brahmacharin, one who lives like a house-holder, one who is a herinit and one who lives like a mendicant, all reach the same high end by duly satisfying the duties of their respective modes of life.

sa: शक्तितश्चरितं वक्ष्ये प्रसादात् तस्य धीमतः। अप्राप्य तु ततोऽनुज्ञां न शक्यः स्तोतुमीश्वरः॥
en: The Supreme Lord is incapable of being worshipped by any one if he does not grant his permission to the worshipper. As for myself, it is only when I become fortunate enough to receive his permission that I succeed in worshipping him.

sa: न यावदेव पच्यते महाजनस्य यावकम्। अपक्व एव यावके पुरा प्रलीयसे त्वर॥
en: Do not think that you should first enjoy all sorts of pleasures and then try to acquire Liberation, for before; you are satiated with enjoyment you may meet with Death. Do you, in view of this, hasten to do acts of goodness.

sa: क्षात्रधर्मिणमण्याजौ केतयेत् कुलजं द्विजम्। न त्वेव वणिजं तात श्राद्धे च परिकल्पयेत्॥
